name: Livestock Breeding and Genomics Lab
affiliation: Department of Animal Science, NC State University
mission: Genetic improvement has made livestock populations substantially more productive, and the challenge now is to sustain that progress while preserving the genetic diversity, health, and resilience on which future selection depends. We study how genomic, phenotypic, and microbial information can be harnessed to that end.
join: We welcome inquiries from prospective graduate students, postdoctoral researchers, and visiting scientists. Please write with a brief description of your interests and background.
pi_title: William Neal Reynolds Distinguished Professor, Department of Animal Science
tagline: Genetics and genomics for efficient, healthy, and diverse livestock
about: Most of our work concerns dairy and beef cattle and pigs, and draws on large genomic and phenotypic datasets assembled with colleagues at NC State and elsewhere.
